issue.title: [Feature] JSON Structure to GraphQL
issue.body:
### What would you like Avrotize to do?

Convert a JSON Structure definition into GraphQL SDL so I can use the same model with GraphQL tooling.

### Example or use case (optional)

A small record with an enum should become a GraphQL type and enum.

### Existing command or Avrotize area (optional)

s2graphql

### Other details (optional)

It would be helpful if the result passed graphql-js schema validation.
